name: Grand Doors
description: Doors one to four blocks wide and one to four blocks tall, in every wood (plain, glazed, tinted and three house-door looks), in stone, iron and copper, plus an iron gate of bars and fence gates two and three wide. With one leaf or two that open in the middle, flat or arched, on the inside or the outside face of the wall. Sneak while placing to make a door swing towards you.
